meta.name: edgeone-makers-edge-functions
meta.description: V8-based lightweight edge functions on EdgeOne Makers. Covers routing, KV storage access, request/response handling, and environment variables at the edge.

copy.tagline_en: Run lightweight JavaScript functions at the edge

howto.what: Claude 能帮你编写和调试在 EdgeOne Makers 边缘运行的 V8 轻量函数，处理路由、KV 存储、请求/响应和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你需要创建或修改边缘函数，或询问关于 EdgeOne Makers 边缘函数的代码、限制、API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个边缘函数，返回 JSON 格式的用户列表。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 onRequestGet 代码。

say.text: 如何在边缘函数中使用 KV 存储？
say.note: Claude 会解释全局变量用法并给出示例。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write and debug V8 lightweight edge functions on EdgeOne Makers, covering routing, KV storage, request/response handling, and environment variables.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or modify edge functions, or ask about code, limits, or APIs for EdgeOne Makers edge functions.

say_en.text: Write an edge function that returns a JSON list of users.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the onRequestGet code.

say_en.text: How do I use KV storage in an edge function?
say_en.note: Claude explains global variable usage with an example.
